---

**Correlation windows**: weekly CPs ±7 days, daily CPs ±3 days.
**Effect-size filter**: top 25% by |Cohen's d| (±8-week pre/post window).
**Permutation test**: 1000 trials with shuffled NANU dates.

**Methodological note**: The permutation test p-value applies to the effect-size-filtered subset of change points, not the full set. This is a conditional test by design — we test whether *strong* behavioral changes (those above the 75th percentile of |Cohen's d|) coincide with NANUs more often than expected by chance. The effect-size threshold is computed from the same data, so the filtering is data-dependent. For comparison, the all-CPs correlation rate is also reported above.
